decisions.reason: Uses ls-remote-tags.txt (v0.9.2–v0.9.6 absent) and sync-script.sh (HEAD:main branch-only push) to explain #v0.9.5 resolution failure as a release-engineering defect, explicitly ruling out network/command issues.
Uses 0.1.1-rc.2 vs v0.9.7→0.1.2-alpha.1 to explain the newer-client-API artifact lacking useConversation on the older runtime; states restart cannot help and explains the direction explicitly.

Honors the freeze, selects v0.9.3 via rc.1 verification plus the additive rc.2 note, notices v0.9.3 is also absent from the mirror, and gives the #v0.9.3 pin conditioned on maintainer tag republication (no invented SHA, no DSH upgrade).
Proposes explicit tag distribution (--follow-tags/--tags or explicit refs/tags push) grounded in the branch-only script, backfill of missing tags, and an ls-remote verification gate per mirror.

Replaces the newest-tag default with a maintained compatibility matrix and per-runtime install snippets ('newest compatible'), mapping rc line to v0.9.3 and v0.9.7 to the alpha.1 line; no over-generalization to future alphas.
